text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":2,"unit":"centimeters","kind":"count","span":"each square has a side that measures 2 centimeters"},{"id":"q2","value":92,"unit":"square centimeters","kind":"count","span":"the total area of the smaller squares is 92 square centimeters"}],"plan":[{"op":"mul","args":["q1","q1"],"out":"s1","note":"side length squared gives the area of one square"},{"op":"div","args":["q2","s1"],"out":"s2","note":"total area divided by area of one square gives the number of squares"},{"op":"mul","args":["s2","q1"],"out":"s3","note":"number of squares times the side length is part of computing the total wire length; the full perimeter calculation also needs multiplying by 4 sides per square, a constant not stated as a number in the text"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"the original length of the wire"},"dismissed":[]}
